summary: Yaroslav Vassilkov is an Indologist who studied at the Faculty of Oriental Studies of St. Petersburg University (~1960–1966). He held posts at the Imperial Academy of Sciences (~1967–1999), Kunstkamera (~1999), and Saint Petersburg State University.

Yasuaki Nara specialized in Buddhist studies and Indology, studying under Kogen Mizuno and Hajime Nakamura at the University of Tokyo and at the University of Calcutta. He held posts at Komazawa University and served as director of the Soto Zen Research Center.

Yasuhiko Nagano is a scholar of Tibetology and linguistics who studied at Tokyo University of Foreign Studies, University of Tokyo, and UC Berkeley (Ph.D.). He held posts at Toyo Bunko, UC Berkeley, National Museum of Ethnology, NIHU, and SOKENDAI.
Yasuhiko Sueki is a scholar of philosophy and Sinology who studied at the University of Tokyo. He served as a professor emeritus at Komazawa University.

Yasuhiro Okazaki is an Indology and philosophy scholar who earned a PhD at Hiroshima University under Atsushi Uno, Shoryu Katsura, and Hiroakira Ono. He held posts at Hiroshima Prefectural Chiyoda, Kabe, and Takamiya high schools.

Yasuhiro Sueki is a Buddhist studies scholar who undertook short-term study under George Baumann at Tübingen University Library (~1993–1994). He held posts at the International Institute for Buddhist Studies (~1980–1996) and the International College for Postgraduate Buddhist Studies (~1996).
Yasuhiro Ueno is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed doctoral studies and held a post at Kyoto University. He was also an entrusted researcher at Koyasan University (attested 2004).

Yasuhiro Yamazaki was a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Koyasan University (~1950–1954). He served as an assistant professor at Shuchiin University (1966–2000) and as a professor at Koyasan University (~1972–2000).

Yasuke Ikari is an Indologist who studied at Kyoto University under Masaaki Hattori and earned his PhD from the University of Chicago. He held posts at Kyoto University, Kindai University, the National Museum of Ethnology, and Harvard University.

Yasumasa Sekine is a religious studies and Indology scholar educated at Tokyo Institute of Technology and SOAS. He held posts at Tokyo Institute of Technology, Gakushuin Women's Junior College, University of Tsukuba, Japan Women's University, and Kwansei Gakuin University.

Yasunori Ejima was a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy who completed his degrees at the University of Tokyo. He held posts at the University of Tokyo, Nagaoka University of Technology, and the University of Göttingen.

Yasuo Deguchi is a philosophy and Buddhist studies scholar who completed doctoral studies at Kyoto University. He held posts at the Nagoya Institute of Technology, ZEN University, and Kyoto University, where he became dean of letters.
Yasuo Goto is a scholar of Buddhist studies who held lecturer and part-time lecturer posts at Ryukoku University (attested 1991, 2006) and Shuchiin University (attested 2006).
Yasuo Inamoto works in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. He served as a technical official at Nara National Museum (~1995–2007) and took up a post at Kyoto University (~2007).

Yasuo Matsunami was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who completed doctoral studies at Taisho University under Ryukai Mano. He served as a lecturer at Taisho University and as an advisor to the Sravakabhumi Study Group.
Yasuo Sano is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Kenyu Mitomo and founded the Buha Bukkyo Shiso Kenkyukai.

Yasuo Yuasa was a philosophy and religious studies scholar who studied under Tetsuro Watsuji at the University of Tokyo. He held posts at the University of Tokyo, University of Yamanashi, Osaka University, University of Tsukuba, and J. F. Oberlin University.

Yasuro Abe works in Japanology, religious studies, and Buddhist studies, having studied at Wako and Otani universities. He held academic posts at Osaka, Otemae, and Nagoya universities, the International Research Center for Japanese Studies, and Ryukoku University.
Yasushi Endo is a scholar of Indology and philosophy who held positions at Nagoya University, International Buddhist University, and Aichi Bunkyo University.

Yasutaka Muroya is a scholar of Indology and philosophy. He has held research associate posts at the University of Vienna, the University of Leipzig, and the Institute for the Cultural and Intellectual History of Asia.
